questions.question: How precisely can a Tower 4 ping locate a phone?
Who had the access to cut the harbor cameras?

out.text: If the ping is accurate, it seriously undercuts his alibi. He swore he never left the Westside Diner between 9:30 and 11:00 PM, but the Tower 4 records place his phone at Pier 9 at 10:14 PM. That doesn't prove he was at Pier 9, though. It shows where the phone was, not who was holding it, and tower pings only give a rough area. Whether it breaks the alibi depends on how precise that location is and whether anyone else had the phone.

results.title: Accuracy Characterization of Cell Tower Localization.pdf · winlab.rutgers.edu
results.snippet: Cell tower ping location accuracy, also known as Cell Site Location Information (CSLI), varies significantly depending on several factors including the density of cell towers, the technology used, and the specific location Naively applying these methods can result in very large localization errors unless the cell falls within the area covered by the wardriving trace In summary, while CSLI can provide a general area of a device's location, the precision can range from a few meters in dense urban areas with advanced technologies to several kilometers in rural areas

out.text: A single tower ping gives an area, not a pin-point. Accuracy depends on how densely towers are spaced: in cities it may narrow things to a few blocks or one sector, while a rural tower can cover a radius of 30 km or more. The episode says the Tower 4 records place Marcus Vance's phone at Pier 9 at 10:14 PM, but it hasn't said how far Tower 4 is from Pier 9 or how the location was narrowed, so the exact precision is still unknown. The ping supports his presence in that tower's coverage area, not that he was at Pier 9 specifically.

out.text: The episode so far doesn't say who had access to cut the harbor cameras. It only says the cameras were "deliberately severed" moments after Vance's phone pinged at Pier 9, which places him on the pier at that time but doesn't show who cut the cameras. The access question is still open, so we'll need to wait for later evidence.

The transcript so far doesn't mention a burner phone being smashed, or any time it was destroyed. The only phone detail is that Tower 4 cell dump records put Vance's phone at Pier 9 at 10:14 PM. That doesn't yet show whether he had a second phone or what happened to it.

The Pier 9 records contradict Vance's sworn claim that he never left the Westside Diner between 9:30 and 11:00 PM. Tower 4 data puts his phone at Pier 9 at 10:14 PM. That shows where the phone was, not who had it, and the episode hasn't yet addressed whether anyone else could have carried it.

The narration doesn't say what detectives found yet. At 30 s it only says the locker discovery at midnight "changes the motive entirely," without naming the item. Details may come later, but I can't tell from what has played so far.
